div.p: 【1】 User loads the web app — Frontend serves the React SPA
【2】 Backend generates a signed JWT (API key + secret) and room name
【3】 Browser connects to LiveKit SFU via WebRTC (RTP/UDP, Opus, DTLS-SRTP)
【4】 SFU forwards the audio stream to the AI Agent Worker (same AZ)
【5】 Worker pipeline (VAD → STT → LLM → TTS) processes and returns synthesized audio
【6】 SFU routes the response audio back to the user's browser
